assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D game BACKGROUND ONLY from the attached visual reference's distant abyss, keeping its illustrated pixel-texture finish and quiet indigo/lavender palette. This will be placed BEHIND a separate playable stone platform, so do not paint any foreground platform, walls, floor, characters, UI, lettering, logo, or skull. Landscape 1536x1024 or wider. Enormous organic neural abyss filling the whole canvas: one giant branching dendritic tree structure in the upper right, dark violet perforated organic boughs spanning the sky, tiny hanging pale-pink synapse buds, one restrained distant ivory-lilac glowing soma nested between branches upper right, many hazy vertical neural stalactites descending into lavender atmospheric depth. Left and bottom mostly low contrast deep blue-violet mist and distant silhouettes so the platform can overlay it. Perceived scale immense; mysterious and beautiful with slight unease; no busy foreground. Hand illustrated materials with visibly discrete fine pixel clusters, atmospheric volumetric depth, refined painterly pixel art. Match reference image's background closely. No bright cyan or red: those colors belong to gameplay. This is an actual game backdrop asset, not a screenshot mockup.

Production 2D game sprite, transparent background. Use attached reference image for art direction. Isolate ONE long modular floating platform CLIFF EDGE facing viewer, running diagonally from upper left to lower right at slope 1:2 (26.5 degrees), usable as a repeating isometric front edge. Dark mineralized neural cortex rock, irregular torn ledge at top, purple-black organic perforated roots and membrane strands draping downward from it, small clusters of tiny pale lilac synaptic buds along the top rim. Cliff face tall and heavy then tapering into ragged dangling fibers at bottom. Broad horizontal sprite with generous transparent margins. Top rim runs from x=100 y=130 to x=1100 y=630, cliff hangs another ~260px below rim, entire object within frame. A narrow blue-gray stone ledge only, NO big floor area, no trees, no characters, no typography, no background rectangle, no bright blue magic. Restrained intricate illustrated pixel-art matching the reference, dark indigo stone, violet roots, sparse pale lilac glowing buds. Must be true alpha cutout, not checkerboard.

Create a game-ready transparent RGBA sprite atlas using attached first image as art direction and attached second image (existing neural-walls-v1) as the exact material/roots/plants style to preserve. FIX GEOMETRY: existing second image contains long thin panels which squash into paper-thin fences when placed into one tile. Need TWO separate single-cell solid blocks, equally sized, horizontally side by side, generous transparent margins, each contained within its half. LEFT: indestructible dark slate-indigo mineralized neural stone cube with sparse violet-black roots draping down sides and 3 tiny pale lavender synaptic flowers at its foot. RIGHT: breakable pale mauve-gray cracked neural stone cube with large structural fissures, small chips, same sparse roots and buds. Isometric 2:1 projection: square ground footprint, both visible side faces equal width, top cap is a diamond TWICE as wide as high. Relative geometry after scaling: block width 100 pixels, vertical extrusion 120 pixels, top diamond height50 pixels, TOTAL silhouette height170 pixels. Two large horizontal courses of stone, each face just 2 broad stones per row. No pillars, no special endcaps, no protruding towers, no crenellations. FLAT DIAMOND TOPS that can seamlessly meet adjacent copies in either axis. Broad blue-gray stone slabs with small natural pits, thick stone volume. Match the reference's thick rough ruined wall material and root tendrils, not metal or futuristic panels. Plants integrated close to the base only, do not dominate. Hand illustrated with fine pixel clusters. Neutral light upper left. NO shadow ellipse outside footprint, no text, no numbers, no ground plane, no background, no extra objects. Keep margins and transparent space between two sprites. Need actual transparent alpha.
